description: One email signature for humans and AI agents. Signatoro is the agentic email signature platform: save your signature once, and your people and every AI agent you connect use the same one.

interface.shortDescription: One email signature for humans and AI agents
interface.longDescription: Signatoro is the agentic email signature platform: save your signature once, and your people and every AI agent you connect use the same one. When you ask Codex to sign an email, or on every email once its instructions say so, it fetches the signature you saved on Signatoro and appends it, so one edit reaches every agent you use or switch to. Each AI agent can sign with a signature of its own, and a company keeps one brand across its people and its agents. Without signing in, make a signature from your name and details and get the install steps for your mail app. Every plan includes the MCP server and API, Free too.
